# Godot 2D 选框工具知识图谱

## 总体结构概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Scene"] --> B["Line2D (边框)"]
    A --> C["Polygon2D (填充)"]
    A --> D["变量集合"]
    D --> D1["startPos: Vector2"]
    D --> D2["endPos: Vector2"]
    D --> D3["selecting: bool"]
    B --> E["显示高亮/蚂蚁线"]
    C --> F["显示选区颜色"]
    D3 --> G["控制输入响应"]
    G --> H["InputEventMouseButton"]
    G --> I["InputEventMouseMotion"]
    H --> J["记录 startPos 并设为 selecting"]
    I --> K["更新 endPos 并调用 updateRectangle()"]
    J --> L["鼠标释放时调用 ClearSelection()"]
```

## 输入处理流程
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A1["MouseButtonPressed"] --> B1["记录 startPos"]
    B1 --> C1["selecting = true"]
    A2["MouseMotion"] --> D1["若 selecting 为 true"]
    D1 --> E1["更新 endPos"]
    E1 --> F1["调用 updateRectangle()"]
    A3["MouseButtonReleased"] --> G1["selecting = false"]
    G1 --> H1["调用 ClearSelection()"]
```

## 矩形点计算与渲染
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S["startPos"] --> P1["point1 = startPos"]
    S --> P2["point2 = (startPos.x, endPos.y)"]
    E["endPos"] --> P3["point3 = endPos"]
    E --> P4["point4 = (endPos.x, startPos.y)"]
    P1 --> L["Line2D.points"]
    P2 --> L
    P3 --> L
    P4 --> L
    P1 --> G["Polygon2D.polygon"]
    P2 --> G
    P3 --> G
    P4 --> G
```
